title: Spectra — Fourier Lab
description: An eighteen-mode interactive Fourier & DSP lab on a from-scratch FFT. NEWEST — the ADAPT mode, where a filter learns its own taps. An adaptive FIR drives a running error e[n] = d[n] − wᵀu[n] toward zero by three from-scratch rules — LMS, normalised NLMS and exponentially-weighted RLS — all chasing the one optimum they share: the WIENER–HOPF least-squares solution wₒ = R⁻¹p, assembled from the sample correlation matrix and solved live by a from-scratch CHOLESKY factorisation, with the resulting MINIMUM MSE drawn as the floor every learning curve descends toward. Four canonical jobs run on the same engine: SYSTEM IDENTIFICATION copies an unknown echo path from noise alone (raise the input coloring ρ and watch R's eigenvalues — from a Jacobi eigensolver — spread apart, LMS crawl, and RLS, which whitens internally, stay untouched); Widrow's ADAPTIVE NOISE CANCELLER learns the leakage path from a reference microphone and subtracts the interference, the error signal itself becoming the recovered signal; the ADAPTIVE LINE ENHANCER predicts only the part correlated across a decorrelation delay, lifting buried sinusoids out of broadband noise so their spectral peaks visibly emerge; and an ADAPTIVE EQUALIZER trained against known symbols collapses the combined channel⊛equalizer impulse response to a single spike, slashing intersymbol interference from ≈−6 to −38 dB and reopening a slammed-shut eye to zero symbol errors. Ensemble-averaged LEARNING CURVES race all three rules head-to-head against the MMSE floor — RLS converging in ~2M samples regardless of eigenvalue spread while LMS's rate visibly tracks it — and the whole subsystem is nailed down by thirteen new self-tests (104 total, all green): Cholesky and Jacobi eigenvalues on hand-checked matrices, Wiener recovering a noiseless plant to machine ε, RLS(λ=1) reproducing the batch least-squares solution, NLMS's exact invariance to input power, and the LMS mean-square stability edge μ < 2/λmax that diverges the instant you cross it. Build a working digital radio in the MODEM mode: bits become Gray-coded BPSK/QPSK/16-/64-QAM symbols, get root-raised-cosine pulse-shaped and pushed through an AWGN channel, and the received constellation, the open EYE DIAGRAM and the transmit spectrum all update live — while the measured Monte-Carlo bit-error rate falls exactly along the closed-form theory curve (a from-scratch erfc/Q-function), the strongest kind of validation. Then flip to OFDM — the multicarrier scheme behind Wi-Fi, 4G/5G and DVB — where an IFFT paints data onto hundreds of orthogonal subcarriers, a CYCLIC PREFIX turns a frequency-selective multipath channel into a plain circular convolution, and a one-tap-per-carrier zero-forcing equalizer snaps the smeared cloud back to a clean grid (toggle it off and watch the echo destroy it). Close the last few dB in the CODING mode — the forward-error-correction pillar: from-scratch CONVOLUTIONAL encoders (K=3…7, including the K=7 (171,133) code that flew on Voyager and rides every Wi-Fi frame) with hard- AND soft-decision VITERBI maximum-likelihood decoding and rate-compatible PUNCTURING (1/2→2/3→3/4→5/6). Watch the VITERBI TRELLIS decode live — the add-compare-select survivor sweep, each state's path metric, and the surviving maximum-likelihood path snapping onto the true transmitted path as channel errors are repaired. See the CODING GAIN as a curve that slides left: the measured coded BER sits under a closed-form UNION BOUND built from the code's own DISTANCE SPECTRUM — enumerated straight from the trellis, so d_free = 10 (a_10 = 11) is re-derived, not looked up — with soft decisions buying the textbook ~2 dB over hard. Then a MESSAGE DEMO drives it home: the same text through the same noise, shredded when sent raw and pulled back intact when wrapped in the code. Beat the FFT's own resolution limit in the RESOLVE mode: two tones inside a single DFT bin — below the RAYLEIGH LIMIT — that the periodogram blurs into one lobe, split cleanly by the subspace super-resolution estimators MUSIC, ROOT-MUSIC and ESPRIT, plus the CAPON/MVDR minimum-variance and BURG maximum-entropy AR spectra, all read from the eigenstructure of the sample covariance matrix via a from-scratch Hermitian (Jacobi) eigensolver, with AIC/MDL counting the sources and the estimates landing grid-free on the z-plane. Reconstruct a CT scan from scratch: the TOMOGRAPHY mode Radon-projects a Shepp–Logan phantom into a sinogram and inverts it BOTH ways — the direct methods (FILTERED BACK-PROJECTION, watch each reading smear back and resolve a sharp slice, and a FOURIER SLICE THEOREM reconstruction that grids each projection's spectrum into k-space) AND the ITERATIVE family (SIRT / SART / CGLS) that solves the whole scan as one least-squares system A x = b over an exact-adjoint projector pair, with a non-negativity prior; starve the scan to few angles or a limited-angle wedge and watch the live convergence curve duck under the FBP baseline as iterative roughly halves the error — with a live RMSE error map and the radial slices lighting up the frequency plane. Trace a glyph or uploaded silhouette into an outline and watch rotating EPICYCLES redraw it. Build and HEAR spectra, filter noise in the frequency domain, read spectrograms, and SHARPEN them: time-frequency REASSIGNMENT and SYNCHROSQUEEZING collapse a fuzzy chirp band to a razor line, with a Rényi-entropy readout. Analyse LIVE MICROPHONE audio in real time (scrolling spectrogram + pitch tuner). DESIGN digital filters on an interactive z-plane — drag poles and zeros and watch magnitude, phase, group delay, impulse response and sound recompute live from a from-scratch bilinear transform (Butterworth, Chebyshev, FIR, biquad, elliptic Cauer, Parks–McClellan equiripple, design-to-spec). Plus a Morlet wavelet vs STFT, a real 2-D image FFT, a phase-vocoder time-stretch/pitch-shift, a JPEG-lite DCT codec, and cepstral pitch detection. Deep-linkable; no math libraries.
